authority.visualAuthority: Only a current Figma canonical master (or an explicitly recorded Figma absence) may authorize a visible local or HarmonyOS surface.
authority.behaviorAuthority: Reader-UI and Core/Host own UiEvent, state owner, data and effects. They never authorize a new visual shape, icon, text hierarchy, layout, viewport or motion on their own.
authority.revisionRule: A historical named version is evidence only. It must not be copied into currentRevision. The official REST current revision is present for every exact-figma-binding record; those records remain non-deliverable until their corresponding Design Delta, local parity, device evidence, and withdrawal enforcement are closed.

routeInventory.unclassifiedRoutePolicy: A route absent from records is not admitted. The verifier reports it and strict mode fails; a renderer/host must fail closed before it can be treated as compliant.
routeInventory.componentPolicy: A visible component absent from records is not admitted, even when its containing route is listed.

classificationDefinitions.exact-figma-binding: The Figma file/page/master/node identity is explicitly recorded. This does not mean visual delivery is approved; deliveryStatus and current revision decide that.
classificationDefinitions.figma-absent-fail-closed: The Figma source deliberately has no visual target. Local and HarmonyOS must refuse to create a replacement visual until the user supplies a Figma source.
classificationDefinitions.figma-unbound-fail-closed: A RouteId exists, but no verified current Figma page/master/node binding exists. This is not a claim that Figma has no content; both runtimes must remain fail-closed until the binding is read and approved.
classificationDefinitions.retired: The user withdrew this surface or state. It must not be reachable or silently replaced by a new visual.
